config.P4_vs_P64_interpretation: cadence/compute/capacity bundle, not isolated frequency effect

config.on_phaseB_failure: stop block and publish partial; no new-method retry or seed substitution
config.on_warm_gate_failure: retain all stages, stop before phaseB
config.phaseB_Sleep_recipe: 16GKD+8LTI per event; same event seed and prefix pool for pre4/post4 at a given primary boundary
config.phaseB_event_pools: 24 train prompts,6/class; fixed per primary4 boundary; P64 uses matching boundary64 pool
config.phaseB_new_schedule: same first112 v3 new batches for every arm
config.phaseB_replay_control: every4 primary steps total12 B4 batches cycling the same24-prompt pool twice; extra gold labels/SGD and CMS-clock advance; not equal-FLOPs or equal-label
config.phaseB_source_freeze: before phaseB launch, after the first common warm budget is selected
config.phaseB_teacher_order_control: same absolute prospective fast weights in both initial students; pre teacher old fast-base, post teacher already-assigned new fast-base; no double gradient application
config.pre4_vs_post4_interpretation: matched event count/slots/optimizer/data; initial student identical for the same entering state; teacher snapshot order differs
config.time_enforcement: cooperative checks between operations; no forced kernel interruption; no extension after timeout
